definitions.explanation: The line of latitude at about 66°33′ south, beyond which the sun does not set on midsummer day and does not rise on midwinter day. It is the southern counterpart of {北極線|ほっきょくせん}.

examples.japanese: ⟦{船|ふね}→船：00775_fune⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{南極線|なんきょくせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{越|こ}えた→越える：02099_koeru⟧。
examples.english: The ship crossed the Antarctic Circle.

examples.japanese: {南極線|なんきょくせん}⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{南|みなみ}→南：00652_minami⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{白夜|びゃくや}→白夜：32662_byakuya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}られる→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: South of the Antarctic Circle you can see the midnight sun.

examples.japanese: {観測船|かんそくせん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{南極線|なんきょくせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{越|こ}える→越える：02099_koeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{厚|あつ}い→厚い：00690_atsui⟧⟦{氷|こおり}→氷：02753_koori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ゆっくり→ゆっくり：00910_yukkuri⟧⟦{進|すす}んで→進む：01225_susumu⟧いった。
examples.english: Once past the Antarctic Circle, the research ship made its way slowly through thick ice.

notes:
WATCH OUT:
As with ⟦{北極線|ほっきょくせん}→北極線：32424_hokkyokusen⟧, Japanese separates the line from the region: {南極線|なんきょくせん} is the line, and ⟦{南極圏|なんきょくけん}→南極圏：30162_nankyokuken⟧ is the area south of it. ⟦{南極圏|なんきょくけん}→南極圏：30162_nankyokuken⟧ is also used loosely for the line itself.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {南極線|なんきょくせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{越|こ}える→越える：02099_koeru⟧: to cross the Antarctic Circle
- {南極線|なんきょくせん}⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{南|みなみ}→南：00652_minami⟧: south of the Antarctic Circle

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{北極線|ほっきょくせん}→北極線：32424_hokkyokusen⟧: the Arctic Circle (the line)
- ⟦{南極圏|なんきょくけん}→南極圏：30162_nankyokuken⟧: the Antarctic region
- ⟦{緯線|いせん}→緯線：26195_isen⟧: line of latitude
